title: Upload Invoices
subtitle: Upload digital or scanned invoices for automatic processing

dropzone.title: Drop files here or click to upload
dropzone.subtitle: Support for PDF, JPG, PNG files up to 10MB

instructions.title: Upload Instructions
instructions.line1: Ensure invoices are clearly scanned or in high-quality digital format
instructions.line2: Supported formats: PDF, JPG, PNG (max 10MB per file)
instructions.line3: AI will automatically extract invoice details including amounts, dates, and VAT
instructions.line4: Processed invoices will appear in the Processing Status page
